title: KrustyLoader_Investigation_5d5
description: Investigate the victim host for any unauthorized or suspicious services running on the system.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: KrustyLoader is a Rust-based malware linked to Ivanti ConnectSecure compromises. It is designed to download and execute a Sliver backdoor. The malware shares almost 100% code similarity among its samples and is used to deliver additional payloads.

levels.title: Investigate Suspicious Services
levels.content: Investigate the victim host for any unauthorized or suspicious services running on the system. Enumerate running services and distinguish legitimate services from malicious ones.
levels.solution: Use the command `systemctl list-units --type=service` to list all services and identify the suspicious service 'rat.service'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the status of all services and look for any that appear unusual or unauthorized.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command `systemctl list-units --type=service` to list all services.

levels.title: Identify Scheduled Task or Timer
levels.content: Determine whether a scheduled task or timer is responsible for automatically executing suspicious activity on the victim host. Identify scheduled execution persistence mechanisms (e.g., cron, systemd timers, Windows Scheduled Tasks).
levels.solution: Use the command `systemctl list-timers` to list all timers and identify the suspicious timer 'session-mgr.timer'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd timers and services to find any that might be related to the suspicious activity.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command `systemctl list-timers` to list all timers.

levels.title: Locate Malware Artifacts
levels.content: Locate files introduced onto the victim system by the malicious software. Correlate suspicious activity with newly created files and identify malware artifacts.
levels.solution: Use the command `ls -la /tmp/.session` to list the contents of the directory and identify the suspicious file '/tmp/.session/stealer.out'.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Investigate the /tmp/.session directory for any suspicious files.

hints.title: Second hint title
hints.content: Use the command `ls -la /tmp/.session` to list the contents of the directory.
